prompts.prompt: Create a COMPLETELY NEW TOWER OF THE NAMELESS battle arena for dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn, called THE CHAIN CATHEDRAL. Attached old tower image is ONLY a rendering-quality and front combat camera reference, not layout/design to copy. Wide cinematic panoramic 2.46:1, 1967x800, polished painterly semi-realistic game environment. Inside an immense ancient tower: colossal black stone gothic buttresses, soaring vertical walls with distant ascending balconies, gigantic iron chains suspended from high vaults framing both sides, an enormous SEALED BRASS GATE in the far back with abstract circular locking mechanism and an empty judgment throne on a distant low dais. Dark crimson glass windows and narrow warm antique-gold light shafts, black iron and aged brass details, muted crimson seal-light at far edges. Give a sense of an endless prison sanctuary and a sovereign boss chamber, majestic and oppressive. COMPOSITION ESSENTIAL: lower 55 percent is a large EMPTY FLAT continuous dark stone combat floor for enemies; horizon/distant dais near 45 percent height. Main floor stays clear with subtle worn radial gold inlay around OUTER edges, chains/stone debris only at foreground corners. No huge symbols or stairs in fighting center. Clear readable mid-gray ground, dramatic dark/gold/crimson architecture above. No people, creatures, boss, UI, text or borders. Fill whole panorama.

Create completely NEW tower boss ARCHONT DER KETTEN / CHAIN ARCHON for dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn. Attached titan is ONLY polished semi-realistic rendering quality and FRONT CAMERA reference, absolutely NOT anatomy/design. New boss: immense grounded TWO-ARMED, TWO-LEGGED gothic armored jailer sovereign, broad BLACK IRON plate armor with aged ANTIQUE GOLD edging and fine abstract engraved reliefs, squared cathedral-buttress pauldrons, a tall sealed crown-like greathelm with FOUR narrow vertical spires and TWO small CRIMSON eye slits, no visible human face. Chest contains a barred iron RELIQUARY CAGE with dim red light inside. Heavy chains cross diagonally around torso and forearms, a few oversized keys at belt. Tattered deep burgundy mantle falls behind legs. His RIGHT HAND holds a massive upright JUDGMENT WARHAMMER beside body, ornate rectangular black-iron/brass head shaped like a miniature sealed gothic gate; shaft gripped near waist, weapon fully visible. LEFT gauntleted hand clenched at other side with a short attached chain loop hanging near thigh, no long chain outside frame. Two heavy planted armored boots, no floating. IDLE pose facing viewer squarely, threatening monumental silhouette, immense shoulder mass, sovereign executioner rather than animal. NO extra arms, moonstone, crescent halo, wings, claws, fur or starfield. Same exquisite detailed game rendering as reference, metallic material definition, muted warm gold/red with cool gray edge highlights for readability. Square 1254x1254; whole crown, hammer, cape, hands, boots and chains fit within central 84 percent width and y7%-94%, generous clear margins, nothing cropped. CLEAN CUTOUT ONLY: no floor, shadow plane, aura, background, smoke, detached particles, text or UI. Genuine transparent alpha.
